13337.watch: Whether he beats out Brashard Smith for the backup job.

11575.outlook: The primary insurance behind James Cook III, who handles enormous volume in the league's best rushing offense. Davis flies under the radar because of a small game-day role, but the handcuff value in Buffalo is unusually high. Only six sources covered him. Yahoo is the most aggressive at RB53.
11575.watch: Cook's health, which is the entire case for rostering him.

13414.outlook: A third-round 49ers rookie and a mild surprise pick - he never cleared 190 touches in four collegiate seasons and did not get a combine invite. He is listed RB2 behind a 30-year-old Christian McCaffrey coming off 450 touches, which is the reason to care. His redraft value rose 241 and dynasty 440 in 30 days. CBS has him RB52, FantasyPros dynasty RB73.

11655.outlook: Questionable with a neck issue and listed RB3 in a Giants backfield now led by Cam Skattebo with Najee Harris added. Tracy produced 200-plus touches and 1,000-plus yards in each of his first two seasons, so the fall down the chart is about scheme fit under John Harbaugh rather than production. ESPN has him RB74 while FantasyPros has him RB55 - a 19-spot spread.
11655.watch: Whether he beats out Najee Harris for the backup role.

11647.outlook: A third Chargers season competing with newcomer Keaton Mitchell for change-of-pace work behind Omarion Hampton. Vidal had four games above 17 fantasy points in 2025, so the ceiling in a spot start is real. Only six sources covered him and they cluster tightly RB59 to RB67.
11647.watch: Hampton's health in a backfield with no clear second option.

7528.outlook: Signed with the Giants and is listed RB2 behind Cam Skattebo. He has been a high-volume, low-efficiency back his entire career and John Harbaugh's offenses have historically used a bruising complement. His dynasty value rose 694 in 30 days, one of the sharpest gains here, on the depth-chart position. ESPN has him RB59 while FantasyPros dynasty has him RB79.
7528.watch: Whether Skattebo's leg holds up - Harris is next in line.

8800.outlook: Listed as Dallas's RB2 behind Javonte Williams, who has no other meaningful competition. His dynasty value rose 739 in 30 days on the depth-chart position alone. NBC has him RB58 while FantasyPros dynasty has him RB88, the widest spread on any back in this range.
8800.watch: Javonte Williams's workload, which is close to a full bell-cow share.

9506.outlook: Questionable and listed RB3 in Tampa Bay behind Bucky Irving and Kenny Gainwell. Irving is coming off a 3.40-yard season, so the backfield is less settled than the depth chart suggests. NBC has him RB55, ESPN RB75 and Yahoo RB75.
9506.watch: Whether Irving's efficiency problems open the door.

13288.outlook: A fifth-round Titans rookie with size, versatility and speed, listed RB3 behind Tony Pollard and Tyjae Spears. FantasyPros dynasty has him RB49 while Fantasy Football Calculator has him RB96 - a 47-spot gap, the largest disagreement on any running back in this file. That is entirely about draft capital versus current role.
13288.watch: Whether Robert Saleh's staff gives him early-down work over Spears.

11643.outlook: Competing with Ollie Gordon II for backup reps behind De'Von Achane in Miami. He has barely cleared a meaningful workload in two seasons. Achane's usage is enormous and the offense is otherwise empty, so the handcuff value is meaningful even if the standalone value is not.
11643.watch: Achane's health in an offense with no other fantasy assets.

8205.outlook: On IR with a back injury after signing with Detroit in the offseason, and listed RB4. This is a ranking-versus-availability contradiction worth flagging: ESPN still has him RB47 and FantasyPros RB60 while he is inactive. Fantasy Football Calculator, correctly, has him RB121. His dynasty value fell 486 in 30 days.
8205.watch: Whether the back injury allows a return at all this season.

5995.outlook: Positioned for a larger role in Baltimore after Keaton Mitchell left, but Derrick Henry remains the workhorse at 32. Hill is a pure passing-down back whose value in full PPR is higher than his rushing profile suggests. Fantasy Football Calculator has him RB50 while FantasyPros dynasty has him RB91 - a redraft-versus-dynasty age split.
5995.watch: Whether Henry's age finally forces a bigger committee.

11370.outlook: Listed RB2 in Green Bay behind MarShawn Lloyd with Josh Jacobs unavailable indefinitely. His dynasty value rose 335 in 30 days on that news. Lloyd's own injury history means Brooks is a legitimate contingency rather than a pure depth stash. CBS has him RB62, FantasyPros dynasty RB83.
11370.watch: Lloyd's durability, which is unproven over a full season.

12048.outlook: On the radar because Kenneth Walker III left and Zach Charbonnet is on PUP, leaving Holani as the direct backup to rookie Jadarian Price in a run-first Seattle offense. Price does not have a receiving profile, which is where Holani could carve out work. His dynasty value rose 287 in 30 days. NBC has him RB64.
12048.watch: Whether he takes the passing-down role Price does not fill.

4147.outlook: Back as Chase Brown's primary backup in Cincinnati, having played 31% of the Bengals' snaps last season, mostly on passing downs. A healthy Joe Burrow raises the value of every Cincinnati role. This is the sharpest redraft-dynasty split among deep backs: ESPN has him RB54 and Fantasy Football Calculator RB52, while FantasyPros dynasty has him RB100 - at 30 there is no future value.
4147.watch: Chase Brown's workload, which grew substantially late last season.

13405.outlook: A sixth-round Commanders rookie listed RB3 behind Jacory Croskey-Merritt and Rachaad White, both of whom are questionable for Week 1. He has good size and a solid efficiency profile. FantasyPros dynasty has him RB55 against a redraft average near RB75, which is the standard rookie premium.
13405.watch: Whether the two questionable backs ahead of him miss time.

13347.outlook: A sixth-round Vikings rookie listed RB3 behind Aaron Jones Sr. and Jordan Mason. He is undersized and struggled with efficiency in college. FantasyPros dynasty has him RB59 while ESPN has him RB85. Kyler Murray's arrival raises the offense but not this role.
13347.watch: Whether Aaron Jones's age opens a path to touches.

11571.outlook: Questionable with a knee issue and listed RB3 for the Jets behind Breece Hall and Braelon Allen. Only five sources ranked him and they cluster RB69 to RB81. He is a deep-league contingency only.
11571.watch: Injuries to both Hall and Allen, which is the only path to touches.

13424.outlook: A seventh-round Colts rookie listed RB2 behind Jonathan Taylor, who led the NFL in carries and touchdowns last season. That handcuff position is the only reason he is ranked. His dynasty value rose 274 in 30 days. Yahoo has him RB67, Fantasy Football Calculator RB82.
13424.watch: Taylor's health after a league-leading carry season.

12495.outlook: Questionable and battling Jaylen Wright for backup reps behind De'Von Achane. He was used sparingly as a rookie and did not do much with it. His dynasty value fell 388 in 30 days, one of the sharper declines among young backs. ESPN has him RB64, Yahoo RB85.
12495.watch: Whether he or Wright emerges as the clear Achane handcuff.

12467.outlook: An intriguing stash as the candidate to back up a 30-year-old Christian McCaffrey, though rookie Kaelon Black is listed ahead of him at RB3. The 49ers backfield behind McCaffrey is genuinely unsettled. His dynasty value fell 212 in 30 days as Black climbed.
12467.watch: Whether he or Kaelon Black is the true McCaffrey handcuff.

11435.outlook: Listed RB3 in Seattle behind Jadarian Price and George Holani, having arrived from Green Bay. The Seattle backfield is wide open by default with Walker gone and Charbonnet on PUP, which is the only reason he is ranked this high. FantasyPros dynasty has him RB65 against an RB75 average.
11435.watch: Whether Price struggles enough to force a rotation.

12504.outlook: Traded to Green Bay in August after a rookie season in Pittsburgh that did not go as planned for a third-round pick. He is listed RB3 behind MarShawn Lloyd and Chris Brooks with Josh Jacobs unavailable. His redraft value rose 127 and dynasty 217 in 30 days. Yahoo has him RB64, Fantasy Football Calculator RB99.
12504.watch: Whether the Packers give him a shot if Lloyd struggles.

6039.outlook: Questionable with a knee issue. He has settled in as Buffalo's change-of-pace and receiving option behind James Cook III, a role with real full-PPR value in a top offense. Fantasy Football Calculator has him RB54 while FantasyPros dynasty has him RB96 - at 28 the dynasty market has written him off.
6039.watch: Whether the receiving role survives Ray Davis's presence.

12544.outlook: Questionable and competing with Bhayshul Tuten and Chris Rodriguez Jr. for a Jacksonville backfield with no established lead. A 2025 seventh-round pick, he is the third name in a three-way race. ESPN has him RB72 against an RB79 average.
12544.watch: Whether Jacksonville's committee resolves in anyone's favor.

12455.outlook: Competing with rookie Emmett Johnson for the No. 2 job behind Kenneth Walker III in Kansas City. His receiving background gives him a path to a passing-down role in an Andy Reid offense that has historically produced fantasy value from that spot. ESPN has him RB67, Yahoo RB94.
12455.watch: Whether Reid uses him as a receiving back the way he has used others.

9757.outlook: Questionable and listed RB2 in New Orleans behind Travis Etienne Jr., with Alvin Kamara having fallen to RB4. Miller has never stayed healthy long enough to establish a role. Yahoo has him RB69 against an RB80 average.
9757.watch: Whether he can stay available long enough to be the Etienne handcuff.

4137.outlook: On IR with a foot injury and listed RB4 in Arizona at 31, with no clear path to touches even when healthy given the No. 3 overall pick is the starter. FantasyPros has him RB69 and CBS RB63 while he is inactive, another availability contradiction - Fantasy Football Calculator has him RB122, which is the accurate read.
4137.watch: Whether the foot allows any return this season.

12471.outlook: Listed RB3 in Indianapolis behind Jonathan Taylor and rookie Seth McGowan. Only five sources ranked him, clustering RB76 to RB88. He is a deep dynasty stash rather than a redraft asset.
12471.watch: Whether he passes McGowan as the primary Taylor backup.

11237.outlook: Listed as Detroit's RB2 behind Jahmyr Gibbs with Isiah Pacheco on IR, which is the entire reason he appears here. Only three sources covered him and the range is enormous - ESPN RB71 against FantasyPros RB100. His dynasty value rose 476 in 30 days on the depth-chart position.
11237.watch: Gibbs's health in an offense with no other back.

11577.outlook: Listed RB3 in Philadelphia behind Saquon Barkley and Tank Bigsby. Four sources covered him and the range is RB78 to RB91. He is a deep-league contingency behind a heavily used starter.
11577.watch: Whether he passes Bigsby as the primary Barkley backup.

6130.outlook: Listed RB4 in a Giants backfield that added Najee Harris and returns Cam Skattebo and Tyrone Tracy Jr. At 29 he is the veteran depth piece. ESPN has him RB113 while Fantasy Football Calculator has him RB75, a 38-spot spread that reflects genuine uncertainty about whether he makes the rotation.
6130.watch: Whether he holds a roster spot through the season.

12543.outlook: Listed RB3 in Cincinnati behind Chase Brown and Samaje Perine. Five sources covered him in the RB83 to RB101 range. He is a deep dynasty flier in a good offense.
12543.watch: Whether he passes Perine for the backup job.

11199.outlook: Listed RB3 in Dallas behind Javonte Williams and Malik Davis. The Cowboys offense is productive enough that the third back matters in deep leagues if injuries hit. ESPN has him RB80, Yahoo RB97.
11199.watch: Whether he passes Malik Davis as the primary backup.

13302.outlook: On IR and listed RB5 in Baltimore. He was a fifth-round pick reportedly handpicked by owner Steve Bisciotti. FantasyPros dynasty has him RB70 against an ESPN RB95 and Fantasy Football Calculator RB127, which is another ranking-versus-availability gap - he is currently inactive.
13302.watch: Whether he returns from IR and gets a look behind Derrick Henry.

8122.outlook: Listed RB3 in Arizona behind Jeremiyah Love and Tyler Allgeier, with James Conner and Trey Benson both on IR. That thin depth chart is why he is ranked at all. Fantasy Football Calculator has him RB70 against a FantasyPros RB101.
8122.watch: Injuries to the two backs ahead of him.

1379.outlook: A 35-year-old fullback listed RB4 in San Francisco and questionable with a finger issue. He is ranked only because Fantasy Football Calculator lists him at RB73 in a format that counts fullbacks as backs. He has no standalone fantasy value in Bobby's leagues.
1379.watch: Nothing - he is a roster artifact of how one source classifies fullbacks.

12476.outlook: Inactive with a hamstring strain and not currently on the New Orleans depth chart. FantasyPros has him RB89 and dynasty RB80 while ESPN, correctly reflecting his status, has him RB128. Another availability contradiction to be aware of.
12476.watch: Whether the hamstring clears and he re-enters the rotation.

13348.outlook: An undrafted Jacksonville rookie in a backfield with no established lead back. Only three sources covered him, and Fantasy Football Calculator's RB78 against FantasyPros's RB111 is the spread. He is a training-camp-buzz name rather than a projection.
13348.watch: Whether Jacksonville's committee opens a path for anyone.

11729.outlook: Listed RB3 in Detroit behind Jahmyr Gibbs and Jacob Saylors, with Isiah Pacheco on IR. Four sources covered him in the RB89 to RB105 range. He is a special-teams and depth piece in a top offense.
11729.watch: Gibbs's health, which would elevate everyone in this room.

11589.outlook: On IR with a knee injury and listed RB6 in Arizona. His pro career has been derailed by injuries since being a 2024 third-round pick. FantasyPros dynasty has him RB74 while Fantasy Football Calculator has him RB124 - the gap is about draft capital versus current availability. His dynasty value fell 370 in 30 days.
11589.watch: Whether the knee lets him return to a backfield that has moved on.

13423.outlook: A seventh-round Steelers rookie and a tweener prospect, listed RB4 behind Jaylen Warren and Rico Dowdle. FantasyPros dynasty has him RB82 against an ESPN RB97 and Fantasy Football Calculator RB110. He is a dynasty flier.
13423.watch: Whether Mike McCarthy finds a specific role for him.

11570.outlook: Listed RB3 in Baltimore behind Derrick Henry and Justice Hill, with Adam Randall on IR. ESPN has him RB86 against a FantasyPros RB108. He is the third body in a backfield where Henry takes almost everything.
11570.watch: Henry's age finally forcing a real committee.

8181.outlook: Listed RB3 in Las Vegas and covered by only two sources, ESPN at RB105 and Fantasy Football Calculator at RB93. He is a fullback-hybrid depth piece with no projectable fantasy role.
8181.watch: Nothing - he is roster filler at this depth.

11579.outlook: Listed RB3 in New Orleans behind Travis Etienne Jr. and Kendre Miller, with Alvin Kamara at RB4. Five sources covered him in the RB83 to RB125 range. He is a deep contingency in a backfield that just added its lead back.
11579.watch: Whether Kendre Miller's injuries move him up the chart.

7564.outlook: Unanimous WR1 across all eight sources, though he is carrying a knee designation into Week 1. He has finished four of five seasons no lower than fifth in points per game, and even in a down 2025 with Joe Burrow missing nine games he still led the position in targets. The 2024 to 2025 drop - 1,740 to 1,426 yards, 17 to eight touchdowns - was almost entirely quarterback-driven. A healthy Burrow restores the ceiling.

9493.outlook: Questionable with an undisclosed issue. He has finished each of his three seasons sixth or better among receivers in points per game and led the NFL with 129 receptions last year while finishing top three in most categories. The one caution is that Mike LaFleur, the coordinator behind that offense, left for the Arizona head job. Davante Adams takes red-zone work but not volume.
9493.watch: Whether the Rams passing game holds up without LaFleur calling it.

9488.outlook: The reigning Offensive Player of the Year led all receivers in target share (36%), receiving yards (1,793), air yards and yards per route run (3.8) while finishing no lower than fourth in targets, catches, touchdowns and fantasy points, with 10 top-10 weeks. Seattle won the Super Bowl and lost coordinator Klint Kubiak, the only real question. Rashid Shaheed and Cooper Kupp are complementary, not competition.
9488.watch: Whether the new play-caller keeps him at a 36% target share.

7547.outlook: The only player in NFL history with 90-plus catches in each of his first five seasons, finishing exactly third among receivers in fantasy points three years running with no worse than fourth in catches, yards and touchdowns each year. He set a career-high target share last season. Detroit's offense returns fully intact. Sources cluster him WR3 to WR4 with no meaningful disagreement.
7547.watch: Nothing situational - this is the most stable profile in the file.

6786.outlook: A bounce-back candidate after finishing 12th in points per game, his worst since 2021. 13311.outlook: A third-round Dolphins rookie and the heaviest receiver in his class at 222 pounds, listed as LWR4. His dynasty value rose 505 in 30 days. FantasyPros dynasty has him WR60 while Fantasy Football Calculator has him WR92. He is behind Malik Washington and Caleb Douglas on the depth chart.
13311.watch: Whether his size earns him a red-zone role early.

13274.outlook: A second-round Steelers rookie with good size and reliable hands, listed as SWR3 behind DK Metcalf and Michael Pittman Jr. Mike McCarthy's offenses have historically produced from the slot. His dynasty value rose 398 in 30 days. FantasyPros dynasty has him WR63 while Yahoo has him WR93.
13274.watch: Whether McCarthy gives a rookie meaningful slot snaps.

7571.outlook: A sixth Baltimore season after an injury-plagued year that limited him to career-low production. He is listed as the LWR2 behind Zay Flowers with rookie Ja'Kobi Lane pushing. The entire coaching staff turned over, so his role is genuinely unsettled. Fantasy Football Calculator has him WR67 while FantasyPros dynasty has him WR97.
7571.watch: Whether the new staff keeps him ahead of Lane.

11834.outlook: Opens as New Orleans's No. 2 receiver behind Chris Olave with Jordyn Tyson on IR, which is a real short-term role. His dynasty value rose 522 in 30 days on exactly that news. ESPN has him WR71 while FantasyPros dynasty has him WR101, reflecting that the role likely ends when Tyson returns.
11834.watch: How many weeks he holds the job before Tyson is activated.

13285.outlook: A third-round Giants rookie, one of the biggest and strongest receivers in his class, listed as the RWR2 behind Malik Nabers. With Nabers's Week 1 status uncertain after ACL surgery and Darius Slayton released, the path to snaps is unusually clear for a Day 2 rookie. Fantasy Football Calculator has him WR101 against a FantasyPros WR78.
13285.watch: Nabers's knee, which directly determines his snap count.

9502.outlook: On IR with an ACL and MCL tear, listed as SWR6, having already missed all of 2025 after the original injury late in 2024. ESPN has him WR58 while FantasyPros has him WR89 and dynasty WR91 - the ESPN ranking is the clearest availability contradiction among receivers, since he is currently inactive with no timetable.
9502.watch: Whether he plays at all in 2026.

13320.outlook: A third-round Falcons rookie and an undersized slot, listed as SWR4 behind Drake London, Jahan Dotson and Olamide Zaccheaus. Kevin Stefanski's offense runs through Bijan Robinson, Drake London and Kyle Pitts. Fantasy Football Calculator has him WR100 against a WR79 average.
13320.watch: Whether he carves out a return-game and gadget role that translates.

12535.outlook: The favorite for No. 3 receiver duties in Detroit behind Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jameson Williams, which is a valuable role in one of the league's best offenses. He is listed as LWR3. FantasyPros dynasty has him WR65 against an ESPN WR94, a 29-spot gap.
12535.watch: Whether Detroit's third receiver sees enough targets to matter.

13301.outlook: A third-round Commanders rookie and undersized slot, listed as SWR3 behind Terry McLaurin and Stefon Diggs. Note that some sources initially listed him as a running back - he is a receiver. FantasyPros dynasty has him WR59 while Fantasy Football Calculator has him WR103, a 44-spot gap driven entirely by draft capital versus current role.
13301.watch: Whether Diggs's age opens the No. 2 job by midseason.

4039.outlook: At 33 he is listed as Seattle's SWR3 behind Jaxon Smith-Njigba and Rashid Shaheed in a run-first offense with a new coordinator. This is one of the clearest redraft-dynasty splits: Fantasy Football Calculator has him WR71 while FantasyPros dynasty has him WR110. His redraft value has fallen to 22, essentially zero.
4039.watch: Whether he holds a starting role at all through the season.

13317.outlook: A third-round Buccaneers rookie from a small school, listed as LWR4 behind Emeka Egbuka, Chris Godwin Jr. and Jalen McMillan. His dynasty value rose 335 in 30 days. FantasyPros dynasty has him WR64 while Fantasy Football Calculator has him WR110 - a 46-spot gap.
13317.watch: Whether Godwin's or McMillan's injuries open snaps.

7090.outlook: Signed with the Giants to replace Wan'Dale Robinson as the No. 2 behind Malik Nabers, listed as SWR3. Darius Slayton's release on September 7 thins the room further. Nabers's ACL recovery makes the Giants receiver depth chart unusually fluid. ESPN has him WR103 against a WR85 average.
7090.watch: Nabers's availability, which determines the whole room's target share.

11637.outlook: Questionable with a foot sprain and listed as Buffalo's LWR3 behind DJ Moore and Khalil Shakir, a steep fall for a player taken 33rd overall in 2024. His FantasyPros ownership rate is 3.2%, which tells you the market has moved on. His dynasty value fell 291 in 30 days. All five sources have him WR85 to WR95.
11637.watch: Whether he wins back a starting role at any point.

11626.outlook: Questionable with a lower-body issue and listed as Carolina's RWR3 behind Tetairoa McMillan and Jalen Coker, having been passed by Coker in the second half of last season. His dynasty value fell 231 in 30 days. ESPN has him WR84, FantasyPros WR97.
11626.watch: Whether he wins back the job Coker took from him.

12483.outlook: A second-round Raiders pick limited to a 36% snap share as a rookie, listed as SWR3 behind Tre Tucker and Jalen Nailor. Brock Bowers absorbs most of the passing volume. Yahoo has him WR85, ESPN WR100.
12483.watch: Whether Klint Kubiak's scheme gives him a defined role.

11627.outlook: Was on his way to a Year 2 breakout midway through 2025 before it stalled. He is now listed as Denver's SWR5 behind Courtland Sutton, Jaylen Waddle, Pat Bryant and Marvin Mims Jr., which is a crowded room after the Waddle trade. FantasyPros dynasty has him WR76 while Yahoo has him WR104.
11627.watch: Whether he climbs back up a suddenly crowded depth chart.

9501.outlook: Listed as New England's SWR3 behind A.J. Brown and Romeo Doubs. Drake Maye's efficiency makes even a third receiver role interesting, but Mike Vrabel's offense leans run-heavy. Fantasy Football Calculator has him WR73 while FantasyPros has him WR104, a 31-spot gap.
9501.watch: Whether New England's slot role produces usable volume.

13413.outlook: Listed as Kansas City's SWR4 behind Rashee Rice, Xavier Worthy and Tyquan Thornton. The wide spread is telling: NBC has him WR77 and Yahoo WR69 while Fantasy Football Calculator has him WR109. Andy Reid's offense can support a fourth receiver in the right circumstances but Mahomes's health is the gate.
13413.watch: Whether an injury ahead of him opens a role.

8188.outlook: Listed as Kansas City's LWR3, a fourth-year receiver who has bounced around. His FantasyPros ownership is 1.5%. Yahoo has him WR83 while FantasyPros dynasty has him WR118 - at 26 with his track record the dynasty market has no interest.
8188.watch: Whether he holds a rotational role in a deep Chiefs room.

8119.outlook: Listed as Atlanta's RWR2 behind Drake London, a real starting role. The disagreement is extreme: ESPN has him WR85 and Yahoo WR84 while FantasyPros has him WR110 and dynasty WR128. Tua Tagovailoa's arrival and Kevin Stefanski's scheme could revive a career that stalled in Philadelphia. He was not in last week's top 100.
8119.watch: Whether the RWR2 role in Stefanski's offense is real volume.

9494.outlook: Questionable with a foot issue and listed as Denver's SWR4 after the Jaylen Waddle trade pushed the whole room down. He has been an explosive part-time contributor and elite return man. Fantasy Football Calculator has him WR78 while Yahoo has him WR116, a 38-spot gap. He was not in last week's top 100.
9494.watch: Whether the crowded Denver room leaves him any route volume.

12497.outlook: Questionable with an undisclosed issue. He looked like a Day 3 find early in 2025 before a season-ending shin injury in Week 9. He is listed as Seattle's SWR4 behind Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Rashid Shaheed and Cooper Kupp. His dynasty value fell 215 in 30 days. All five sources have him WR95 to WR104.
12497.watch: Whether the shin is fully healed and he reclaims a rotational role.

10218.outlook: Listed as Houston's LWR4 but ranked here because the room behind Nico Collins is genuinely thin - Tank Dell is on IR and Jaylin Noel is hurt. The disagreement is large: ESPN has him WR86 and Fantasy Football Calculator WR79 while FantasyPros has him WR112 and dynasty WR131. He was not in last week's top 100.
10218.watch: Whether the injuries ahead of him persist into the season.

11533.outlook: Unanimous K1 across all five sources that rank kickers, the only kicker with a perfect 1.0 average. Aubrey's range makes him usable from distances other kickers never attempt, and Dallas's offense generates a high volume of scoring drives without always finishing them, which is the ideal kicker profile. Only relevant in the Rutgers DU Alum and Patty'sBaddies leagues.
11533.watch: Any change to Dallas's red-zone efficiency.

8259.outlook: Questionable for Week 1. He is the consensus K2 behind Aubrey, with FantasyPros, ESPN and Fantasy Football Calculator all ranking him second. The Chargers offense under Justin Herbert is consistently in scoring range and Jim Harbaugh's teams have been field-goal friendly.

3451.outlook: Ranked K2 by CBS and Yahoo and K3 or K4 elsewhere. Houston's offense stalls in the red zone often enough to generate field goal volume, which is what makes him valuable even though the Texans do not score at a high rate. Playing indoors helps.
3451.watch: Whether Houston's red-zone efficiency improves under a healthier offense.

2747.outlook: Ranked K3 to K5 by every source, kicking for the defending Super Bowl champions in a run-first offense that reaches the red zone frequently. Seattle lost its offensive coordinator, which is the only variable.
2747.watch: Whether the new play-caller changes Seattle's scoring rate.

11786.outlook: FantasyPros has him K4 and CBS K5, while Fantasy Football Calculator has him K10 - the widest kicker disagreement in the file. Jacksonville's offense under Liam Coen produces volume and Little has elite leg strength for long attempts.
11786.watch: Whether Jacksonville converts more red-zone trips into touchdowns.

5189.outlook: Ranked K6 to K9 across the board. San Francisco's offense should be productive if Christian McCaffrey and George Kittle are healthy, and Kyle Shanahan's teams reach the red zone at a high rate. The opener is in Melbourne.
5189.watch: Whether San Francisco's injured skill players return on schedule.

12015.outlook: The most volatile kicker ranking here: ESPN has him K5 and Fantasy Football Calculator K5, while FantasyPros has him K13 and Yahoo K13. He kicks for a Rams offense that led the NFL in yards and points last season, which is the case for the aggressive rankings.
12015.watch: Whether he holds the job - the low rankings suggest doubt about him personally.

11539.outlook: Ranked K7 to K13. Detroit's offense is among the best in the league, which produces both a high scoring rate and enough stalled drives for field goal volume. Dan Campbell's aggressiveness on fourth down is the counterargument.
11539.watch: Detroit's fourth-down aggressiveness cutting into attempt volume.

12711.outlook: FantasyPros has him K7 and Yahoo K6, while CBS has him K15. Baltimore's offense with Lamar Jackson generates scoring drives, but Derrick Henry's goal-line usage converts more of them into touchdowns than field goals.
12711.watch: Whether the new coaching staff changes Baltimore's red-zone approach.

11792.outlook: Fantasy Football Calculator has him K6 and Yahoo K7, while FantasyPros has him K16 - a 10-spot spread. Kyler Murray's arrival should raise Minnesota's scoring rate, and Reichard kicks indoors at home.
11792.watch: Whether Minnesota's offense improves enough to generate attempt volume.
